sources.title: Stanford University CS231n: Deep Learning for Computer Vision
sources.snippet: This course is a deep dive into the details of deep learning architectures with a focus on learning end-to-end models for these tasks, particularly image classification. During the 10-week course, students will learn to implement and train their own neural networks and gain a detailed understanding of cutting-edge research in computer vision.
